{{Quote|Work on the speech, and be very careful. Senator Ton found a listening device in her office.|Bail Organa, to Mon Mothma|audio=Ton-WelcomeToTheRebellion.flac|<ref name="Welcome" />}}
'''Ton''' was a [[senator]] within the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]].<ref name="Welcome" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|209}}</ref> she discovered a [[listening device]] inside her office, a fact that her fellow Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] became aware of. Organa later informed his colleague [[Mon Mothma]] about the device while discussing her plans to practice an anti-Imperial speech, prompting Mothma to have her own [[Mon Mothma's Senate office|office]] searched. This led to the discovery of a listening device planted there by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], who were monitoring several senators.<ref name="Welcome" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ton was mentioned in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]," the ninth episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']],<ref name="Welcome" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
